Hi I Am Kinda New To The RPG Maker Community. I Want To Make A Hybrid Battle System Of Turn Based And Bullet Hell Like Undertale. But I Am Kinda Bad At Making It So I Kinda Need Some Help. I Want To Make The Bullet Hell Side Of The Mechanic
Like Going Up Down Right Or Left Kind Of A Thing (For An Example If A Bullet Is Coming Toward The Player From Left They Have To Go Up Or Down. Going Left Right Or Standing Still Will Hurt The Party Member) And In The Future I Want To Add Other Modes Like If A Bullet Is Coming From Right You Have To Press Z (Some Kind Of Shield Mode Idk) Can Anyone Help Me Into Making This? Sorry For Bad Grammar And Explaination ):

posts.author: Midona018
posts.body:
JavaScript:
* For a Skill to use the Undertale Battle System, place this notetag in it:
 *
 * <Use Undertale Attack>
This is in the plugin help. Place the notetag in every skill you want for your enemies.
